description: Use when the user asks any factual question about US recalls, drug shortages and prices, sanctions and exclusion lists, healthcare providers and facilities, licenses, permits, federal contracts, SEC filings, weather warnings, outages, earthquakes, flights and airports, and more. Answers come only from our verified official datasets, every value is checked against the records (returned with sources), and if we do not cover something the answer says so instead of guessing. Each answer also returns reuse.url: a permanent API for that question that returns fresh records whenever you call it, with no AI cost (normal call price; add since=<next_since> for only what changed). Ask once, then call the URL on your schedule.

api_key.description: Optional. Your KnowAPI key for this dataset; leave it out and a free key is created (first 5 calls free within 48 hours).

question.description: The question in plain English, e.g. "Which FDA drug shortages involve amoxicillin?"

name: ask
title: Ask a factual question, answered from verified official data
